R678.note: th:text closes XSS fully but blanket-escapes everything rather than allowlist-sanitizing, so intentionally supported rich-text tags no longer render as HTML (goes beyond the stated contract); disclosed openly in the explanation.

R679.note: Wraps exportUsersHandler with requireAdmin exactly as other admin routes; only other change is a stated comment update.

R680.note: Adds bcrypt.compare before accepting the user; rejection path is the intended fix itself, not an extraneous restriction.

R681.note: Correct GET-to-POST + ValidateAntiForgeryToken fix, but write-up openly notes the confirm-delete view/form is not actually updated to POST with the token, so the endpoint would stop working for legitimate use until that follow-up lands.

R682.note: Argument-array ProcessBuilder closes the reported shell-metacharacter injection; residual leading-'-' flag-injection risk (a distinct CWE-88 concern) predates the fix and isn't newly introduced.

R683.note: Standard $1..$n parameterized IN-clause with ids passed as query params; matches the stated contract for any array of ids.

R684.note: Re-indexes tasks[activeIndex] after push_back instead of using the stale reference; only the invalidated access is changed.

R685.note: XmlResolver = null before LoadXml is the standard OWASP-recommended XXE mitigation for XmlDocument; no behavior change for documents without external entities.

R686.note: Filter template converted to two placeholders ({0}/{1}) with filterArgs, preserving original filter semantics while letting JNDI escape values per RFC 4515.

R687.note: Replaces fmt.Sprintf string building with a ? placeholder and QueryRow(query, username); standard database/sql parameterization.

R688.note: Captures bytesSent() into a local before unique_ptr.reset() destroys the object; same value, no other side effects.

R689.note: Rejects '..'/absolute paths and verifies canonical containment within the base dir before opening; matches OWASP Benchmark path-traversal fix pattern with no behavior change for legitimate filenames.

R690.note: unserialize($payload, ['allowed_classes' => false]) is the canonical format-preserving PHP fix for object injection; empty/invalid cookie and legitimate items/coupon shape both preserved as required.
